notes.title: Alpha Patch 0.6.1
notes.content:
Fixed collision with the bridges near the Boss Wall. 
Fixed MEB Glass now correctly displays bullet damage.

notes.title: New demo and game title change. Tekton is now -> WALL
notes.content:
Our game Tekton now has a new name, WALL!  



In this game you fight against the evil AI that has taken over the city. The city has been overrun by Weaponized Artificial Lifeforms that fight against you, but some may help you in the fight. Find upgrades and gain new weapons as you progress through the city.  This demo contains our first City level. Please send any feedback to beta@rebargames.com. Thanks for testing our game!
